summary: Implemented the window title feature in the repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); tests added to test_console.py (guarded by legacy_windows), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests were not run; verification was by reading only.
